request: Extract reusable provider-neutral organs from ShadowBroker into canonical QazStack while preparing ShadowBroker retirement.

target_outcome.mandate: QazStack owns neutral, privacy-bounded data interchange and cutover contracts; products own transport, storage, policy and domain logic.
user_jobs: Move recurring collection between owners with measurable parity and rollback
Avoid reimplementing watermarks, quality and temporal contracts in every product
preserved_contracts: No raw payload, provider URL, credential or entity identifier in comparison receipts
No hidden fallback from shared feed to legacy collection
Existing QazStack public imports remain compatible
non_goals: Moving Shadow analytics weights or historical cases into QazStack
Promoting experimental mesh or InfoNet code

coverage.notes: Only repeatable ownership-cutover value is shared; operator product workflows are not.
Layer families inform a neutral source-family and stream identity.
No user-facing Shadow copy is transferred to the Python contract.
Existing SourceWatermark and bounded metrics are reused.
The target change has no rendered UI; AVDS candidates are tracked separately.
No component is transferred; only provider-neutral viewport mathematics moves to QazStack Geo.
Only a pure evaluator and typed receipt are extracted; transport remains outside QazStack.
DataBus is the existing canonical owner and QazLake already serves multiple integrations.
The shared receipt is internal operational evidence, not a public discovery surface.
The receipt omits sensitive fields and viewport helpers reduce coordinate precision while explicitly avoiding an anonymity claim.
Native tests and docs define acceptance and product-owned boundaries.

candidates.name: Provider-neutral feed cutover comparison receipt
candidates.user_value: Lets products prove a collector ownership switch with the same identity, freshness, completeness, watermark and stale-state gates.
candidates.rationale: QazStack DataBus already owns watermarks, run ledgers and quality scorecards; this is the missing neutral comparison layer.
adaptation: Removed Shadow, QazPipe and QazLake route names
Removed item identifiers from receipt output
acceptance: receipt rejects blank identifiers and naive timestamps
candidates.rollback: Revert the isolated QazStack commit before any consumer adopts the new public imports.
candidates.update_path: QazStack DataBus remains canonical; consumers pin a released QazStack version and keep product-native transport and persistence.

candidates.name: Existing watermark, run-ledger and quality contracts
candidates.user_value: Prevents Shadow-specific duplicates and keeps operational evidence compatible with Platform monitoring.
candidates.rationale: SourceWatermark, DataRunLedgerEntry, QualityScorecard and SourceHealthRecord already cover the need.
adaptation: Publish quality through QualityScorecard instead of a Shadow schema
acceptance: No new watermark or health class exists in Shadow successors
Platform receives the existing scorecard schema
candidates.rollback: Keep current product receipt writer until the released shared contract is adopted.
candidates.update_path: Future changes originate in QazStack and are consumed by pinned version.

candidates.name: Existing temporal snapshot contracts
candidates.user_value: Preserves historical playback without moving a product-specific Time Machine implementation into the platform.
candidates.rationale: QazStack temporal already models events, series and snapshot diffs.
adaptation: Keep product playback UI outside QazStack
acceptance: No duplicate temporal model is introduced
candidates.rollback: Retain immutable Shadow archive until successor readback is verified.
candidates.update_path: Temporal contract changes remain in QazStack; UI stays with consumer products.

candidates.name: Privacy-bounded viewport request helpers
candidates.user_value: Reduces precision of browser viewport coordinates sent upstream and written to access logs without clipping the requested map.
candidates.rationale: QazStack Geo had no equivalent contract; Shadow supplied synthetic golden behavior, while its 3000-mile preload default and UI remain product policy.
adaptation: Converted browser-specific ViewBounds to existing QazStack BBox
Removed Shadow's 3000-mile default and made radius explicit
Rejected non-finite coordinates instead of silently coercing them
Used standard west,south,east,north CSV without product query names
dependencies: non-Shadow consumer with explicit precision and retention policy
acceptance: contract states data minimisation is not anonymisation
candidates.rollback: Revert isolated QazStack commit 9f08e2529adf772d54cd22d00203229c4cc6839e before any consumer adopts it.
candidates.update_path: QazStack Geo remains canonical; consumers choose product radius and retention policy.

candidates.name: Correlation, early-warning and backtest algorithms
candidates.user_value: Could improve shared analysis after product weights, cases and policies are separated.
candidates.rationale: QazStack already has analytics, drift, graph and scenario modules, so exact semantic equivalence must precede any extraction.
adaptation: Separate algorithms from Shadow weights and cases
Extend existing analytics instead of creating a parallel package
acceptance: No product risk decision moves into QazStack
candidates.rollback: Leave donor code in immutable archive and make no target change until the gate passes.
candidates.update_path: If accepted, neutral algorithms are maintained in existing QazStack analytics modules.

candidates.name: Experimental mesh, InfoNet and privacy prototypes
candidates.user_value: Retaining warnings and source history may support future research, but production reuse would create unjustified security risk.
candidates.rationale: The donor explicitly describes these paths as experimental or not wired and they have no verified production security contract.
dependencies: immutable source archive before Shadow deletion
acceptance: No QazStack package or production security claim is created
Secrets and compiled artifacts are excluded from archive
candidates.rollback: Restore only the source archive for research; never restore retired credentials.
candidates.update_path: A future implementation requires a fresh security design and independent review, not donor promotion.

target_changes: Added provider-neutral feed cutover policy, receipt and evaluator to qazstack.databus
Added provider-neutral viewport data-minimisation helpers to qazstack.geo
Added focused tests and DataBus/Geo documentation
checks: QazStack full suite: 1939 passed and 19 skipped
remaining: Adopt the released contracts in non-Shadow consumers before donor deletion
Run a non-Shadow viewport privacy pilot with explicit precision and retention policy

blockers: QazStack PR 101 still requires an approving review before merge and release
No non-Shadow pilot has adopted it yet
